data_authority.banked_read: every row carries a banked_read block with Nova's axis and X-point positions and flux, the EFIT reference counterpart, the admitted O and X candidate counts, the retained flux margin to the second-best candidate on each type, and the read status with its exception text on failure. The counts and margins are also readable in candidate_table_status per point type; axis and saddle displacement components in millimetres are banked in axis_displacement_components_mm and saddle_displacement_components_mm.

data_authority.catalogue_format_qualification: efm is a raw read-only Zarr catalogue group rather than an IMAS IDS, so it has no DD version to infer or open; the governed machine-description seam it is compared within is authored and reopened at its written DD version
data_authority.class_margin_readability: nova_post_cutover_class_margin is null when the read is diverted because a diverted read admits no finite reachable wall minimum, so its margin serialises as positive infinity and the receipt cannot distinguish a comfortably diverted row from one a hair from limited. nova_post_cutover_class_margin_finite is the same signed margin with a finite wall level on every resolved row: the visible wall level minus the X-point normalised level, negative exactly when the class is limited. nova_post_cutover_class_margin_finite_wall_source records whether the accepted reachable wall minimum or the rejected supplied wall candidate supplied the visible wall level.
data_authority.cocos_resolution: source COCOS 3 is the measured MAST convention declared by mast_solve_inputs; the solve seam converts typed quantities to DD COCOS 17. R and Z are ONE_LIKE geometric coordinates, so their conversion factor is exactly one and the EFIT geometry is overlaid without a sign or scale edit
data_authority.legacy_label_trap: ForwardTopologyState.diverted is the legacy geometric topology label and is not the post-cutover achieved class. This artifact derives achieved class only from the saddle-aware class margin: non-negative or positive infinity is diverted; negative is limited.

distance_method.axis_m: Nova banked magnetic axis to the EFIT efm magnetic axis
distance_method.boundary_rms_m: root mean square of both directed nearest-polyline sample distances on the same per-branch resampling
distance_method.boundary_sup_m: shared symmetric sampled Hausdorff distance after 2000-point arc-length resampling of the valid spline-assembled closed branch and the closed EFIT polyline
distance_method.compound_path_rule: the spline assembler types one axis-enclosing closed branch and separate open legs; only the valid closed branch enters metrics
distance_method.limiter_contact_m: Nova limiter point to the nearest exact EFIT LCFS and governed-wall segment intersection; null when none exists
distance_method.x_point_m: Nova selected saddle to the nearest finite EFIT efm X-point
